explore.welcome: Open jobs at {companies} companies, straight from their own job boards. Search by job and city, or find what is a short bike ride from home.

anywhere.title: From anywhere
anywhere.intro: Found a company that hires? Send it to joblist from the page you are on: joblist finds its job board and fills in the form, you check and save.
anywhere.share.title: From your phone
anywhere.share.text: Install joblist: in your browser's menu, choose Install app or Add to Home screen. Then on a company website, a job board or a job ad, tap Share and choose joblist.
anywhere.bookmarklet.title: From your computer
anywhere.bookmarklet.text: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar. On a company website or a job page, click the bookmark: joblist opens in a new tab with the company and the job board it links to.
anywhere.bookmarklet.help: Drag it to your bookmarks bar; clicking it here does nothing.
anywhere.bookmarklet.code.help: Or make a new bookmark and paste this as its address.
anywhere.agents.title: For AI assistants
anywhere.agents.text: In browsers with WebMCP, an AI assistant can search companies, jobs and lists here, and fill in the add form for you to check and save.
home.title: Companies that hire, chosen by people
home.intro: Lists of companies by city or field, made by anyone with a Bluesky account: each one is also a live job board.
quick.label: Search

list.delete.title: Delete “{name}” for everyone?

form.list.editing: You are editing your list “{name}”. Saving changes it in your account, for everyone who sees it.
